title: ITR Filing Last Date 2026: What You Need to Know
author: Admin
excerpt: A quick rundown of this year's income tax return deadline, who it applies to, and what happens if you miss it.
content:
Every year, the due date for filing an Income Tax Return (ITR) becomes one of the most searched compliance questions among salaried individuals and small business owners alike. For most non-audit taxpayers, the ordinary due date falls on 31 July, though the government occasionally extends this window in response to portal issues or representations from professional bodies.

## Who needs to file

If your gross total income exceeds the basic exemption limit, or you meet certain other conditions such as holding foreign assets, being a signatory on a foreign account, or depositing large sums in a current account, you are required to file a return regardless of your final tax liability.

## What changes if you miss the deadline

Filing after the due date attracts a late fee under Section 234F, interest on any unpaid tax under Section 234A, and the loss of certain benefits — most notably, the ability to carry forward capital losses to future years. A belated return can still be filed, but only up to the end of the assessment year, after which the window closes entirely.

## Our recommendation

Start collecting your Form 16, interest certificates, and investment proofs at least a month before the deadline. Waiting until the final week increases the risk of portal slowdowns and data-entry errors. If your situation involves multiple income heads, foreign income or capital gains, book a consultation early — accurate filing takes time, and correcting an error after submission is a longer process than getting it right the first time.

title: ITR Filing Last Date 31 July 2026: Miss Kiya To Kya Hoga?
author: Admin
excerpt: Samajhiye ki agar aap 31 July ki deadline miss kar dete hain to kya consequences ho sakte hain, aur ab kya karna chahiye.
content:
31 July ki ITR filing deadline har saal lakhs taxpayers ke liye ek important date hoti hai. Agar aap is date tak apna return file nahi kar paate, to iska matlab yeh nahi ki aap file hi nahi kar sakte — lekin kuch consequences zaroor jud jaate hain.

## Deadline miss karne ke consequences

1. **Late fee** — Section 234F ke under, deadline ke baad file karne par late fee lagti hai, jo aapki income ke hisaab se vary karti hai.
2. **Interest on tax due** — Agar koi tax outstanding hai, to Section 234A ke under uspar interest charge hota hai jab tak aap file nahi karte.
3. **Loss carry-forward khatam** — Kuch capital losses ko agle saalon mein carry forward karne ka option sirf on-time filing par milta hai.

## Ab kya karein

Agar deadline nikal chuki hai, aap belated return file kar sakte hain — lekin ye bhi ek fixed window ke andar hi possible hai, uske baad ye option bhi band ho jaata hai. Isliye jitni jaldi ho sake, apne documents ready karke return file karwa lein. Hamari team aapke liye is process ko fast aur error-free bana sakti hai — bas apne Form 16, bank statements aur investment proofs ready rakhein aur humse contact karein.

title: MSME Registration in Delhi: Benefits and Process
author: Admin
excerpt: MSME (Udyam) registration unlocks credit, subsidies and protection against delayed payments. Here's how the process works in Delhi.
content:
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) registration — now issued as an Udyam Registration Certificate — gives small businesses access to a range of government schemes that aren't available to unregistered entities.

## Why it matters

Registered MSMEs get priority access to collateral-free loans under government-backed credit schemes, interest rate subventions, and protection under the MSME Development Act against delayed payments from buyers — including a mechanism to claim interest on overdue invoices.

## Who can register

Eligibility is based on investment in plant and machinery or equipment, and annual turnover, split across micro, small and medium categories. Both manufacturing and service enterprises are eligible.

## The registration process

Udyam Registration is done entirely online through a self-declaration process linked to your PAN and GST details — no supporting documents need to be uploaded, but the information you provide is cross-verified against government income tax and GST records. Any mismatch can delay or invalidate the certificate.
